item.title: Another viral AI doomsday report claims ‘it’s over.’ Why home prices could take a hit as screen-based jobs disappear.
item.description: Egan-Jones has become the latest to issue a viral AI doomsday report, zeroing in on difficulties facing screen-based workers and the housing market.
item.dc:creator: Barbara Kollmeyer

item.title: ‘I don’t want to die on the sales floor’: I’m 67 and earn $19.50 an hour at a big-box store. When can I finally retire?
item.description: “I started taking Social Security at 66 and receive $2,410 a month. I have $214,000 in my 401(k).”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: Amazon is hiking chip-rental prices and reportedly moving Nvidia processors off the balance sheet
item.description: In a sign of the financing crunch facing the hyperscalers financing the AI revolution, Amazon has announced it is raising prices on how much it charges to rent high-performance microchips as it reportedly is going to sell and then lease back Nvidia chips.
item.dc:creator: Steve Goldstein

item.title: Famed former Boston Celtics commentator lists sunny Boston penthouse for $1.5 million
item.description: A piece of sports history has officially hit the market, with former Boston Celtics commentator Mike Gorman listing his Boston penthouse for $1.495 million.

item.title: ‘I have $400,000 in equity’: I’m 80. Should I sell my house because of dangerous stairs — or spend thousands renovating?
item.description: “Generally, the advice I’ve read says not to sell because I have a low-interest-rate mortgage.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: I’m 71 and still working. I earn $108,000 a year. Am I doing the right thing?
item.description: “I have $152,000 in my IRA and Roth accounts.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: My wife never went back to work after raising our kids. Do I have to share my retirement savings 50/50?
item.description: “For 14 years I have gotten up every morning and gone to work while she has been free to pursue whatever interested her.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: Here’s who’s joining the S&P 500 in the index’s latest shakeup

item.dc:creator: Claudia Assis
Emily Bary

item.description: The company has faced struggles in China and in its sneaker business.
item.dc:creator: Bill Peters
